name: Ritz Penha Longa Resort
positioning: Resort set among the Sintra mountains in a natural park, woven around a 14th-century monastery, with a 27-hole golf course and a spa in its own building (official name: The Ritz-Carlton, Penha Longa Resort)
best_for: Golfers who want a 27-hole course at the resort
Travelers who want Michelin-starred dining and a spa in a natural park
Families with children up to 12 years old

facts.text: The resort sits among the Sintra Mountains in a 220-hectare natural park.
Spices serves dishes from across Asia, including Thailand, Vietnam, China, India and Japan.
A Chef's Table experience is offered at the Arola restaurant.
The resort serves an afternoon tea inspired by Sintra's local pastries.
The golf course has two circuits, the Atlantic Championship and the Monastery.
The resort has an indoor pool, an outdoor family pool and an outdoor infinity pool.
The Penha Longa Kids program is designed for guests up to 12 years old.
Bathrooms have separate showers and Diptyque amenities.
Hotel rooms with terraces overlook the golf course or the resort.
The beaches of Cascais and Estoril are about 10 minutes away.
The spa offers signature treatments using Natura Bissé.

highlights.text: LAB by Sergi Arola holds one Michelin star (2026).
The resort weaves a 14th-century monastery and chapel into its contemporary setting.
The resort has a 27-hole golf course designed by Robert Trent Jones Jr. within the Sintra-Cascais Natural Park.
The spa, guided by Zen philosophy, occupies its own building within the Sintra-Cascais Natural Park.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the location is remote and transport is needed to reach Sintra town center.
Restaurant opening times and days might be adjusted without prior notice.
The Aqua poolside restaurant is seasonal.
